actions.title: Contact your bank and report promptly
steps: Use independently verified bank channels for urgent help.
For financial cyber fraud, call 1930 or use the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
Do not wait to finish collecting evidence before seeking help. Recovery is not guaranteed.

actions.title: Protect the affected account
steps: Do not share more secrets. Contact the account provider through its official app or website.
Use a trusted device for account recovery if the current device may be affected.
If money was lost, follow the financial-fraud actions immediately.
actions.editorialNote: Trusted-device recovery is an engineering safety recommendation, not a quoted official procedure.

actions.title: Avoid sensitive activity on the affected device
steps: Stop using the affected device for banking or account recovery until you obtain trusted help.
Use another trusted device to contact your bank or account provider.
ScamShield cannot determine whether an app is malicious or certify this device is clean.
actions.editorialNote: Conservative product guidance; no automated uninstall, reset or malware diagnosis.

actions.title: Verify through a separate official channel
steps: Do not use the contact details or links in the suspicious message to verify it.
For a bank request, open the official bank app or find its official contact details independently.

actions.title: Consider official communication reporting
steps: Use Sanchar Saathi/Chakshu for suspected communications and follow its current category instructions.
For financial loss or cybercrime use the appropriate cybercrime pathway instead.

actions.title: Check what happened
steps: If you are unsure, check whether you shared secrets, installed software or sent money.
You can use urgent help without waiting for an analysis result.
actions.editorialNote: Product question, not an official reporting procedure.

actions.title: Find official cybercrime reporting
steps: For cybercrime concerns beyond suspected communication, use the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
Follow the current official category instructions. This app does not submit a complaint for you.
actions.editorialNote: Portal purpose supported by official sources; current live form must be verified in #2.
